title: Giant Pacific Octopus Ka 50mm Escape Secret! 🐙 #shorts
idea: The giant Pacific octopus can weigh up to 270 kg yet squeeze through a 50 mm hole, lays 400,000 eggs, and has blue copper-based blood.

lines.text: Giant Pacific octopus ek 50 mm chhote hole se bhi nikal sakta hai!
Iska weight 270 kg tak aur arm span 9.8 meter tak ho sakta hai!
Lekin iska shareer sirf 50 mm ki chhotisi jagah se squeeze ho jata hai!
Ye octopus ek baar mein 400000 tak ande de sakti hai!
Aur iska khoon laal nahi balki copper ke kaaran neela hota hai!
Kya aapne kabhi neele khoon wala jaanwar dekha hai? Comment karo!

facts.claim: Giant Pacific octopus body can compress through tiny spaces as small as 50 mm.
The largest recorded Giant Pacific octopus weighed 270 kg with a span of 9.8 m.
Giant Pacific octopus can lay up to 400,000 eggs.
